title: Glowing pancakes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g>
    <!-- plate -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="40" ry="12" fill="#cfe8ff"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="38" ry="10" fill="#eef8ff"/>
    <!-- bottom pancake -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="32" ry="10" fill="#e8a33d"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="32" ry="9" fill="#f7c76a"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="32" ry="9" fill="none" stroke="#ffdd95" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- middle pancake -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="57" rx="30" ry="9" fill="#e8a33d"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="30" ry="8" fill="#ffd27f"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="30" ry="8" fill="none" stroke="#ffe6ad" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- top pancake -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="46" rx="28" ry="9" fill="#e8a33d"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="28" ry="8" fill="#ffcf70"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="28" ry="8" fill="none" stroke="#ffe6ad" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- butter pat -->
    <rect x="42" y="32" width="16" height="7" rx="2" fill="#fff3b0"/>
    <rect x="42" y="32" width="16" height="3.5" rx="2" fill="#fffbe0"/>
    <rect x="42" y="35.5" width="16" height="3.5" rx="2" fill="#ffe680"/>
    <!-- syrup drip on top pancake -->
    <path d="M30 44 Q34 48 33 53 Q33 57 30 56 Q28 55 29 50 Q29 47 30 44Z" fill="#b5651d"/>
    <path d="M30 44 Q32 47 31.5 50" stroke="#e8903a" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>
    <!-- more syrup -->
    <path d="M70 44 Q72 49 71 54 Q70 58 68 57 Q66 56 67 50 Q68 46 70 44Z" fill="#b5651d"/>
    <!-- steam -->
    <path d="M40 28 Q36 22 40 16" stroke="#ffd9a0" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
    <path d="M52 26 Q48 19 52 12" stroke="#ffd9a0" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
    <path d="M64 28 Q60 22 64 16" stroke="#ffd9a0" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
    <!-- glow highlight on plate -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="20" ry="4" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.35"/>
  </g>
</svg>
